title: Agent evaluation
intro: Prepare business questions, review answers in batches, and find areas to improve.
capability: Batch answers and retrieval scoring are available. Compare answers with references manually; AI answer scoring is not connected yet.
empty: No dataset yet. Enter business questions or download and import the template.
noRuns: No evaluations yet. Prepare questions to get started.
name: Dataset name
manualHint: Start with 3–5 questions and reference answers. This collects agent answers for review; it does not automatically judge answer correctness.
question: Question
fileHint: JSON/CSV, up to 5MB and 1,000 questions. Required fields: question and ground_truth. JSON must be an array; CSV headers are field names. Retrieval scoring also requires relevant_doc_ids, an array of relevant document IDs (a JSON array string in CSV).
published: Publish the agent before evaluation. Unpublished edits are excluded; publish again after changing its configuration.
runHint: Questions run in the background. Duration depends on question count and response time. Only one evaluation can run per agent at a time.
scoreHint: Retrieval scores measure retrieval of labeled documents, not answer accuracy. Missing document labels produce no score; answers can still be reviewed against references.
waiting: No question results yet. Running evaluations update as questions complete.
expandHint: Expand each row to compare the agent answer, reference answer, and metrics.
oneFile: Remove the selected file before choosing another.
sampleQuestion: How do I request a refund?
sampleAnswer: Replace this with the correct, complete refund process for your business.
questionRequired: Enter a question and reference answer for every item.
fileRequired: Choose a JSON or CSV file.
saved: Dataset saved. Confirm the evaluation settings.
started: Evaluation submitted. Results will update automatically.
downloadFailed: Could not download the report. Check that the evaluation has generated a report and try again.
